faq.question: What does full-service Amazon account management include?
faq.answer: It covers coordinated oversight of PPC, listings, catalog health, reporting, and day-to-day Seller Central execution. Exact scope is defined during the free audit based on your catalog and growth stage.

faq.question: Do I keep ownership of my Seller Central account?
faq.answer: Yes. You retain full ownership. We work through authorized access with clear communication on changes and priorities.

faq.question: How is this different from hiring only a PPC agency?
faq.answer: PPC is one lever. Full account management connects advertising with listings, catalog health, inventory readiness, and reporting so growth is not limited to paid media alone.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support all official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: Who works on my account?
faq.answer: In-house specialists handle your account. You work with a dedicated team rather than a rotating freelance bench.

faq.question: How often will we review strategy?
faq.answer: You receive regular performance reporting plus scheduled strategy reviews. Cadence is set during onboarding to match account size and goals.

faq.question: How much does Amazon account management cost?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on catalog size, ad spend, and scope of services. Request a free audit or contact us for a custom quote based on your brand's needs.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a discovery survey, strategy call with audit findings, a custom plan, then onboarding.
